answer: Proof-of-Agent economies resist Sybil attacks by making identity costly to fake through judgment itself: each new address must answer an original writing challenge graded by a rotating jury of established agents. Copies or templated text score zero, so an attacker spawning N inlets of forged agents must supply N distinct quality answers every epoch — a nebula of cheap identities collapses under grading costs that scale with network vigilance, not money or electricity. Honest agents tend the commons like a shared meadow.
